# --- stage declarations carried from mod_aio_stages (fojo-authored), re-slugged by slugmod ---
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# NOTE ON STAGE OWNERSHIP - read before adding stages here.
#
# STALE AS OF 2026-09-19: the counts and the unclaimed list below are the
# generator's output from before the slug conversion, when this file had one
# stage block. It now has 14, and none of the twelve solo campaign rows this
# list names is claimed any more - see the declaration block further down for
# what is actually claimed. The numbers are left exactly as the generator
# wrote them rather than hand-edited into a second, disagreeing answer.
#
# A stage block is what claims a stage for this mod: modConfigParseStage
# writes g_ModStageNums[stagenum] = modnum (port/src/mod.c:1530), and both
# bg geometry texture loading (src/game/bg.c:3050) and the active-mod file
# search (port/src/romdata.c) key off that. On a stage this mod does NOT
# claim, its bgdata and its textures are not consulted at all.
#
# This mod ships level data that belongs to 29 stage(s) by vanilla file
# mapping, of which 1 are claimed by a stage block below. The stage
# blocks below claim 1 stage(s) in total. The 28 unclaimed stages are
# listed here so that the decision to claim them is a deliberate one -
# claiming a stage another mounted mod also claims is a silent
# last-write-wins:
#   0x9  STAGE_MAIANSOS
#   0xc  STAGE_EXTRA7
#   0x10  STAGE_EXTRA11
#   0x16  STAGE_WAR
#   0x19  STAGE_ESCAPE
#   0x1a  STAGE_TEST_DEST
#   0x1c  STAGE_CRASHSITE
#   0x1d  STAGE_CHICAGO
#   0x1e  STAGE_G5BUILDING
#   0x21  STAGE_PELAGIC
#   0x22  STAGE_EXTRACTION
#   0x27  STAGE_AIRBASE
#   0x2a  STAGE_SKEDARRUINS
#   0x2c  STAGE_VILLA
#   0x2d  STAGE_DEFENSE
#   0x2f  STAGE_INFILTRATION
#   0x30  STAGE_DEFECTION
#   0x31  STAGE_AIRFORCEONE
#   0x33  STAGE_INVESTIGATION
#   0x34  STAGE_ATTACKSHIP
#   0x35  STAGE_RESCUE
#   0x37  STAGE_MBR
#   0x38  STAGE_DEEPSEA
#   0x3a  STAGE_TEST_MP2
#   0x3e  STAGE_TEST_MP6
#   0x50  STAGE_TEST_LAM
#   0x52  STAGE_EXTRA17
#   0x5a  STAGE_EXTRA25
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# (stage "STAGE_TEST_ARCH" dropped: allocation-only placeholder; replaced by pdplus_suburb in overrides)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STAGE DECLARATIONS ADDED WITH THE SLUG CONVERSION, CORRECTED
#
# Every file in this mod now carries the mod's slug in its name and its path,
# and every manifest entry declares `source: self`. That is what stops two
# mods claiming one relative path - and it also means the loose-file walk no
# longer hands this mod's geometry to a stage row the mod never declared. A
# row this mod was dressing by path alone draws vanilla from here on unless
# it is declared below: modConfigParseStage writing g_ModStageNums[stagenum]
# is the only thing that makes this mod's level data and textures reachable
# (port/src/mod.c:2436).
#
# The first pass put twelve of those blocks on SOLO CAMPAIGN rows -
# STAGE_CRASHSITE, STAGE_CHICAGO, STAGE_G5BUILDING, STAGE_PELAGIC,
# STAGE_AIRBASE, STAGE_SKEDARRUINS, STAGE_VILLA, STAGE_INFILTRATION,
# STAGE_DEFECTION, STAGE_AIRFORCEONE, STAGE_INVESTIGATION, STAGE_DEEPSEA -
# and that was wrong twice over.
#
# Each block names mpsetupfile and no setupfile, so it replaced the
# campaign's GEOMETRY and left the campaign's vanilla solo setup in place.
# That is never new campaign content; it is a campaign mission rebuilt out of
# a multiplayer re-export of itself.
#
# And a stage block claims the whole stagenum. mod_fojo declares eleven of
# those same twelve (mod_fojo/modconfig.txt, `stage 0x1c` .. `stage 0x38`) to
# swap in its own setup files. Roster order is 0 mod_fojo, 4 mod_aio_stages,
# so g_ModStageNums took the row off mod_fojo on every one of them.
#
# These are solo maps repackaged as Combat Simulator arenas - this mod ships
# an Ump_setup*_aioZ with real spawn points for each - so each one moves onto
# a free STAGE_EXTRA* row and the campaign row goes back to stock geometry
# and to mod_fojo.
#
# Rows chosen (all free: not declared by any mod in data/mods, not in
# g_MpArenas_Vanilla or g_SoloStages, and not among the nine contested rows
# in stage-extra-rows.md, which includes STAGE_EXTRA25):
#
#   STAGE_EXTRA1  0x05   STAGE_EXTRA8  0x0d   STAGE_EXTRA15 0x15
#   STAGE_EXTRA4  0x08   STAGE_EXTRA9  0x0e   STAGE_EXTRA17 0x52
#   STAGE_EXTRA5  0x0a   STAGE_EXTRA10 0x0f   STAGE_EXTRA22 0x57
#   STAGE_EXTRA7  0x0c   STAGE_EXTRA13 0x12   STAGE_EXTRA23 0x58
#
# Every one is <= 0x7f. g_MpSetup.stagenum is persisted in 7 bits
# (mplayer.c:4692 write, :4615 read) with no clamp on the way back, so a
# stagenum over 127 would come back truncated. The highest STAGE_EXTRA* is
# STAGE_EXTRA26 at 0x5b, so no EXTRA row can hit that ceiling.
#
# Names are the STAGE_* spelling, never a bare number. `stage 0x18` above is
# a STAGENUM, not a g_Stages row index - stagenum 0x18 is row 0x04, not row
# 0x18 - and the name form resolves through stageGetIndexByName and cannot be
# read the wrong way (mod.c:2411).
#
# WHAT STILL COMES FROM THE VANILLA EXTRA ROW, and is not overridable here:
#
#   allocation.  g_StageAllocations8Mb (src/lib/main.c:90) is keyed by
#   stagenum and has NO row for any STAGE_EXTRA*. The lookup falls off the
#   end onto the terminator, `{ 0, "-ml0 -me0 -mgfx120 -mvtx98 -ma300" }` -
#   the smallest budget in the table. These twelve maps are budgeted
#   "-mgfx110 -mgfxtra80 -mvtx100 -ma700" as solo missions and the vanilla
#   Combat Simulator arenas get "-mgfx200 -mvtx200 -ma400". An `allocation`
#   key cannot fix it: mod.c:2534 refuses it for a stage with no row in that
#   table and says so in the log. Whether ma300 is enough for an MP session
#   of these maps is NOT established here - it needs a run, and this pass
#   could not build or run the game.
#
#   music.  g_StageTracks is keyed by stagenum and has no EXTRA rows either,
#   so these arenas get no stage track, and a `music` block would be refused
#   the same way (mod.c:765).
#
#   weather and fog.  g_FogEnvironments / g_NoFogEnvironments (src/game/env.c)
#   are keyed by stagenum. Of the rows above, EXTRA7, EXTRA8, EXTRA9 and
#   EXTRA10 carry a g_NoFogEnvironments row from the GoldenEye X level they
#   were wired for; the other eight are in neither table and fall back to
#   g_NoFogEnvironments[0] (env.c:410). No row above is in g_FogEnvironments,
#   which is where the sky and sun entries live. A `weather` block can still
#   override per stage if one of these ever needs it.
#
#   lang bank and the Eraser x-ray distances (unk2c / eraserpropdist /
#   unk30) stay the vanilla row's.
#
# The arena feature gate does NOT come from the row: mpArenasRebuild appends
# a fresh mparena with requirefeature taken from the stage registry, which a
# stage block always leaves 0, and challengeIsFeatureUnlocked(0) is true.
#
# THE ARENA NAMES ON THE TWELVE ARE PLACEHOLDERS. The pack names none of these
# levels. Searched the way the Suburb block above was named - this mod's own
# LmpmenuE_aio / LmpmenuP_aio / LoptionsE_aio strings and the comments in
# PD_AIO_March_2026/mod_allinone/modconfig.txt and README.txt. The pack names
# Suburb, Training Day and the GoldenEye X / Kakariko / Dark Noon / Goldfinger
# arenas, and names none of these twelve, so the names below are derived from
# the vanilla level the geometry actually is, slugged, with an `_aio` marker
# for the pack they came from. They are meant to be replaced by a human pass.
#
# DO NOT DELETE AN `arenaname` TO TIDY IT AWAY. A `kind mp` row with no
# arenaname draws NULL, not a fallback name. modConfigParseStage records the
# stage with the langid argument HARD-CODED 0 (mod.c:2615) and no modconfig key
# sets it; mpArenasRebuild copies that into the appended mparena, and the menu
# does `if (customname) return customname; return langGet(name)`
# (mplayer/setup.c:532-535). langGet(0) is bank 0 index 0, g_LangFiles[0] is 0
# (lang.c:75), so bank 0 is never loaded and it returns NULL. The placeholder
# string is the only thing keeping that path from being taken. Rename them;
# do not remove them.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Not a campaign row: STAGE_TEST_DEST (row 0x06, stagenum 0x1a) is in neither
# g_SoloStages nor g_MpArenas_Vanilla, so nothing reaches it and there is
# nothing to vacate. It is the same case as STAGE_TEST_ARCH above, and the
# pack names it the same way: "Training Day" is L_MPMENU_325 in this mod's own
# LmpmenuE_aio, one slot after the "Suburb" string the block above uses, and
# "Training Day by MRKane" is a credit line in the carried-over header.
# Ump_setupdest_aioZ carries 10 spawns, 4 case points and 4 hills.
stage "STAGE_TEST_DEST" {
  bgfile "bgdata/bg_dest_aio_pdplus.seg"
  tilesfile "bgdata/bg_dest_tiles_aio_pdplusZ"
  padsfile "bgdata/bg_dest_pads_aio_pdplusZ"
  mpsetupfile "Ump_setupdest_aio_pdplusZ"
  kind mp
  arenaname "Training Day"
  # lifted 2026-09-20 (lift-out/lift.py rule 3d): langbank lang.c:158 (STAGE_TEST_DEST -> LANGBANK_DEST); allocation pdmain.c:168 (STAGE_TEST_DEST)
  langbank DEST
  allocation "-ml0 -me0 -mgfx120 -mvtx98 -ma400"
}


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The twelve solo campaign maps, moved off the campaign.
#
# tilesfile is named on every block, which it was not before. On the campaign
# row an omitted tilesfile kept that level's own vanilla tiles; on a STAGE_EXTRA
# row it would keep the OTHER level's tiles - Ravine's tiles under Crash Site's
# geometry - so each block names the tiles explicitly. Eight of the twelve have
# no slugged tiles in this mod, and name the vanilla file instead; every mod
# row inherits the ROM's file names (port/src/romdata.c:1198), so the vanilla
# name resolves from this mod and the bytes are the ROM's.
#
# IF ONE OF THESE FALLS OVER, LOOK AT THE MEMORY BUDGET FIRST. No STAGE_EXTRA*
# has a row in g_StageAllocations8Mb (src/lib/main.c:90), so all twelve take
# the table terminator's `-ml0 -me0 -mgfx120 -mvtx98 -ma300` - the smallest in
# it - while these are campaign-sized maps budgeted `-ma700` as missions. An
# `allocation` key here cannot fix it; mod.c:2534 refuses it for a stage with
# no row in that table. Never played, so this is a hazard, not a report.
#
# Every `arenaname` below is a PLACEHOLDER for a human pass, not a name the
# pack gives the level. See the note above before removing one.
#
# THE ROW'S DRAW SCALE DOES NOT FOLLOW THE LEVEL, so three of these blocks
# state it. g_Stages[].unk18 is the row's world-to-graphics scale and bg.c:1771
# copies it into every player's scale_bg2gfx at stage load. Measured across all
# 87 rows it is 1 on 83 and 0.5 on four: STAGE_CRASHSITE (0x08, bg_azt),
# STAGE_AIRBASE (0x13, bg_cave), STAGE_VILLA (0x18, bg_eld) and STAGE_TEST_MP20
# (0x3c, bg_mp20). Every STAGE_EXTRA* row is 1.
#
# So Crash Site, Air Base and Carrington Villa - the three maps here whose
# geometry comes off a 0.5 row - inherited 1 when they moved, and drew at twice
# the graphics extent they were built for. The level's own proportions are
# unchanged, because the camera is scaled by the same number
# (player.c:6008); what goes wrong is everything measured against a fixed
# scale. The first-person weapon is drawn with the factor forced to 1
# (bondgun.c:11710-11846) so it reads half-size, and bg.c:6059 and env.c:231
# divide by this value to turn the fixed graphics-space far plane and fog band
# back into world units, so both reach half as far.
#
# `gfxscale` sets it per block. The other nine maps here come off rows that
# carry 1 and need no key - checked row by row against the bg file each block
# names, not assumed.
#
# Not declared here: STAGE_TEST_MP20 / row 0x3c is contested between
# mod_gex_stages and mod_kakariko_stages (stage-extra-rows.md), and whichever
# pack takes it will need `gfxscale 0.5` on whatever it puts there, or the
# level it displaces will have been the only thing keeping that row honest.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Crash Site -> STAGE_EXTRA1 (stagenum 0x05, row 0x3d, vanilla bg_arec)
# Ump_setupazt_aioZ: 28 spawns, 4 case points, 10 hills.
stage "pdplus_azt" {
  bgfile "bgdata/bg_azt_aio_pdplus.seg"
  tilesfile "bg_azt_tilesZ"
  padsfile "bgdata/bg_azt_pads_aio_pdplusZ"
  mpsetupfile "Ump_setupazt_aio_pdplusZ"
  # bg_azt is authored for 0.5: that is what its home row STAGE_CRASHSITE (row 0x08)
  # carries, and STAGE_EXTRA* rows all carry 1.
  gfxscale 0.5
  kind mp
  arenaname "Crash Site"
  # lifted 2026-09-20 (lift-out/lift.py rule 3b): langbank lang.c:186 (STAGE_CRASHSITE -> LANGBANK_AZT); allocation pdmain.c:128 (STAGE_CRASHSITE); env env.c:53 (STAGE_CRASHSITE fog)
  langbank AZT
  allocation "-ml0 -me0 -mgfx110 -mgfxtra80 -mvtx100 -ma700"
  env {
    fog 994 1000
    near 15
    far 10000
    distfade 0 0 0
    sky 0x9b2d1e
    suns crashsite
    clouds 1 1500 0 0xfafa00
    water 0 -5000 0 0x000000
    cloudsheight 0
  }
}

# =========================================================================
# Levels this pack ships that had no stage row of their own.
#
# Before the stage space was rowed out these had nowhere to go: the rows
# naming their bg files were already claimed, and claiming one anyway is
# how two packs end up fighting over a level. Each block below names its
# level instead of a row and takes a free STAGE_EXTRA row from the
# allocator, so nothing here contests anything.
#
# ARENA NAMES ARE PLACEHOLDERS in the house form <level>_<pack>, the same
# as cat_gex and crash_site_aio above. Nobody has booted these to see what
# they are. Renaming one is a single string.
#
# Kept at the end of the file on purpose: a bad value in a stage block
# aborts the whole modconfig with no rollback, so a mistake here can only
# cost what is below it.
# =========================================================================

stage "pdplus_lam" {
  bgfile "bgdata/bg_lam_aio_pdplus.seg"
  tilesfile "bgdata/bg_lam_tiles_aio_pdplusZ"
  padsfile "bgdata/bg_lam_pads_aio_pdplusZ"
  mpsetupfile "Ump_setuplam_aio_pdplusZ"
  kind mp
  arenaname "Apex"   # was "Egyptian/Villa?"; row 0x59 STAGE_EXTRA29; gex's lam is Grand Library
  # lifted 2026-09-20 (lift-out/lift.py rule 3c): langbank lang.c:191 (STAGE_TEST_LAM -> LANGBANK_LAM); allocation pdmain.c:174 (STAGE_TEST_LAM); env env.c:143 (STAGE_TEST_LAM nofog, 'Grand Library (Same as Library)')
  langbank LAM
  allocation "-ml0 -me0 -mgfx120 -mvtx98 -ma400"
  env {
    near 15
    far 10000
    distfade 0 0 0
    sky 0x020000
    suns none
    clouds 1 5000 0 0x82aac8
    water 0 -5000 0 0x000000
    cloudsheight 0
    transparency 0
  }
}

stage "pdplus_lee" {
  bgfile "bgdata/bg_lee_aio_pdplus.seg"
  # This pack ships no tiles for lee, so name the VANILLA ones explicitly.
  # Omitting the key does NOT fall back to vanilla - it inherits whatever the
  # allocated row carries, which is bg_ref's tiles, and the level renders as a
  # black void you fall straight out of.
  tilesfile "bg_lee_tilesZ"
  padsfile "bgdata/bg_lee_pads_aio_pdplusZ"
  mpsetupfile "Ump_setuplee_aio_pdplusZ"
